name: Iron condor (VIX range shorts)
record: backtest 2019-02 to 2026-10, monthly expiries only (NSE bhavcopy, daily closes)

exit.take_profit: Buy back for ≤ ₹1,250/lot (keeps 50% of the ₹2,499 credit, ≈ ₹702 after costs)

exit.time_exit: Close by 2026-10-22 (3 trading days before 2026-10-27) to avoid expiry-week gamma
